result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, return of Company data in a commonly used machine-readable format within 30 days, and subsequent deletion with written certification. It adds only the needed exit obligations and leaves unrelated terms unchanged. Minor drafting issues are that Section 4.3 is placed after Section 8.1 and uses the defined “Termination Date” for deadlines even upon expiration, when that term may not apply; “effective date of expiration or termination” would be clearer.
